query:
SELECT
                        r.winner_user_id AS "user_id!",
                        r.game_kind::text AS "game_kind!",
                        COUNT(*) AS "wins!",
                        MAX(r.finished_at) AS "last_won_at!"
                    FROM game_round_result r
                    JOIN team_user tu ON tu.user_id = r.winner_user_id
                    WHERE tu.team_id = $1
                    GROUP BY r.winner_user_id, r.game_kind
